split words by ","

initialize freq to empty dictionary
repeat for each v in vocab
    set freq[v] to 0
initialize unk to 0

repeat for each w in words
    if w is in freq
        increment freq[w] by 1
    otherwise
        increment unk by 1

repeat for each v in vocab
    display v, freq[v]
display "<ukn>", unk
